Keep visible front/other side plain warm cream with one thin muted ochre waist band. Do NOT show broad front-facing panels, add duplicate right panels, move hidden hardware onto the front or invent a window/cockpit. This is a physical new W view, NOT a flat mirrored E picture: upper-left SCREEN lighting remains in the same screen position, hull shading is freshly rendered for W.

No tiny rear-side duplicate pads, fifth leg, skid or extra support. Preserve hull diameter/height/profile and all feet/pivots/pads/strut lengths, bell and waist proportions. Upright vertical rocket, no tilt.

READY, original feet deployed. Final W: original panels are NARROW LEFT-EDGE TANGENT slivers, THREE visible long feet and fourth physically hidden; same physical model and screen light.
